# SciSpace

> > SciSpace is a comprehensive academic publishing platform providing journal templates, manuscript formatting tools, and citation management for researchers across all disciplines.

SciSpace offers automated formatting templates for thousands of academic journals from major publishers including Elsevier, Springer, Wiley, Nature, SAGE, and Taylor & Francis. The platform supports both LaTeX and MS-Word outputs, streamlining the manuscript submission process with publisher-specific formatting, citation styles, and submission guidelines.

## Key Topics

- Journal Templates
- Manuscript Formatting
- Academic Publishing
- LaTeX Output
- Citation Management
- Submission Guidelines
- Publisher Templates (Elsevier, Springer, Wiley, Nature, SAGE)
- Research Paper Formatting
- Citation Styles
- Word Templates
- Zibeline International Publishing
- Impact Factor & Citation Metrics
- Manuscript Submission
- Mendeley Integration
- EndNote Compatibility

## Publisher Template Collections

- [American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics - Templates](https://scispace.com/formats/american-institute-of-aeronautics-and-astronautics): Browse 10 AIAA journal templates for aerospace engineering submissions

## Zibeline International Publishing Templates

- [Acta Informatica Malaysia (AIM) Template](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/acta-informatica-malaysia-aim/0dfdf7bfaae344da816b957959b8251b): AIM journal template for Zibeline Publishing with Word/LaTeX output
- [Food and Agri Economics Review (FAER) Template](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/food-and-agri-economics-review-faer/1c5fa9977c5c48caa47a9244f223e078): FAER template for agriculture economics journal submissions
- [Ecofeminism and Climate Change (EFCC) Template](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/ecofeminism-and-climate-change-efcc/873a3eaf5c3e4c88aa50a70d16096972): EFCC journal template for ecofeminism & climate change research
- [Acta Chemica Malaysia (ACMY) Template](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/acta-chemica-malaysia-acmy/53fa8d62d4714ceda78ac7ca57213a8f): ACMY chemistry journal template for Zibeline Publishing submissions
